title: Graph Engine Overview
summary: This module provides a robust framework for defining, executing, persisting, and visualizing complex directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) or state machines, enabling structured workflow orchestration.

nodes.label: Define & Execute Graphs
nodes.title: Graph Definition & Execution
nodes.description: This sub-module provides the core components for defining graph structures, including nodes, steps, and joins, and orchestrating their execution.

nodes.label: Persist Graph State
nodes.title: Graph State Persistence
nodes.description: This sub-module handles saving and loading the state of graph runs, enabling features like resuming interrupted executions and inspecting historical states.

nodes.label: Visualize Graph Structures
nodes.title: Graph Visualization Utilities
nodes.description: This sub-module offers tools to generate visual representations of graph structures, typically by converting them into Mermaid diagram syntax.

groups.label: Core Graph Logic
groups.title: Core Graph Definition & Execution
groups.description: Encapsulates the fundamental components for defining, building, and running directed acyclic graphs or state machines.

groups.label: Supporting Services
groups.title: Graph Management & Presentation
groups.description: Provides essential services for managing graph state (persistence) and presenting graph structures visually (visualization).
